groups.activity: earn a Death Mark, then kill (Shadow/Protector) Stalker

rows.label: Hate Blueprint
rows.note: 5.87% per Stalker kill (11.73% within a 50% table); untradeable

alt.text: or the "What Stalker?" bundle, prorated down if you already own Dread/Despair

conditions: Only the killing blow earns the mark: if a squadmate finishes the boss, they get it, not you.
Excluded bosses grant no mark: Captain Vor (Mercury), Corrupted Vor, Ropalolyst, Zealoid Prelate, The Fragmented, H-09 Efervon Tank.
Spawn chance is 1.5% + 0.5% per marked squad member (2% solo, 3.5% with a full marked squad), arriving 30-280s into the mission; the window closes around 5 minutes.

He cannot spawn in Assassination or Syndicate nodes, Sorties, Archon Hunts, Arenas, free roam, Archwing, Sanctuary Onslaught, relays/dojos, Albrecht's Laboratories, Höllvania or Dark Refractory missions.
Warframes below rank 10 block the spawn entirely.
If Stalker downs you, the mark is spent and he despawns immediately, even if you are revived before bleedout.
bonuses: Run the Hyena Pack (Psamathe, Neptune) for marks: each Hyena can grant its own.
The Sergeant (Iliad, Phobos) is the fastest single-boss mark: Volt, Gauss or Titania clear it in well under a minute.
Public squads raise spawn chance to 3.5% and are free.

disclosures.title: the maths behind the reputation
disclosures.body: The wiki's own expectation is ~17 kills, 114 ± 38 to be near-certain, stacked on a 2-3.5% spawn chance per mission. This makes Hate the most notorious "years and still don't have it" drop in the game: measured in playtime, not sessions.

disclosures.title: beacons are a mixed bag
disclosures.body: Stalker Beacons (125,000 cr + 200 Ducats, Baro Ki'Teer, rotating stock) guarantee the spawn but not the drop. One well-known cautionary post burned 4,800 Ducats on 24 beacons for 21 Dreads, 1 Despair, no Hate, under the old table; post-Update-36 odds run roughly twice as good as that story implies.

disclosures.title: the plat bundle gets a near-unanimous no
disclosures.body: 444-725p buys ten-plus Warframe slots and reactors, and the drop lands eventually anyway, though a handful of buyers did report it dropping within days of purchase.
